parent_objective: freeze matched-budget L0/L1/L2/L3 training design before any new training or comparison
blocked_by: M2224 confirms L3 smoke checkpoint is weak and matched-budget training is needed
supersedes: single-profile L3 retraining without matched-budget controller matrix
direct measured rerun from weak smoke checkpoints

public_gates: M2226 must define a matched-budget L0/L1/L2/L3 training matrix
M2226 must preserve the P0 human-view no-wheel no-oracle actor contract
M2226 must specify seed policy, training budget, quality floors, checkpoint materialization, readiness, and reset/runtime smoke admission gates
M2226 must explicitly block profile-specific tuning, ranking, paper claims, finite-window-vs-GRU verdicts, and self-ID claims
M2226 must not run reset, rollout, measured execution, policy action, training, replay, or PPO
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: moves from weak-smoke checkpoint diagnosis to a fair matched-budget training plan
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: training design only; no training rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if design trains only L3 without matched profile budgets
stop if design weakens actor contract or uses hidden/oracle inputs
stop if design permits ranking before checkpoint/readiness/reset gates
fallback_plan: route to config-generation implementation if design is complete
route to synthesis if matched-budget route is too expensive or underspecified
route to bounded negative report if no fair training route is feasible

admission_evidence: M2225 admits design only before training
allowed_updates: M2226 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by design
next_stage_criteria: budget and seed policy are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2226 designs training and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2226.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Finite-window or current-response success after matched-budget training must be treated as a valid engineering outcome, not forced into a GRU claim.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: opens matched-budget training branch from checkpoint-quality evidence
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: prepares fair profile training before comparison
must_synthesize_if: M2226 cannot define a fair profile matrix

hypothesis: A matched-budget training design can remove the weak-smoke checkpoint blocker without overclaiming finite-window or GRU evidence.
success_criteria: design defines profile matrix, budgets, seeds, quality floors, checkpoint materialization, readiness, reset/runtime smoke, and post-training route
no reset rollout measured execution training ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: design trains only L3 without matched profile budgets
design allows ranking before admission gates
new rollout or training is performed
decision_rule: M2226 passes if it freezes a fair matched-budget training design without running training or ranking.
